description: This file contains the implementation of the 'List' feature for articles, including the 'Query' request definition and its handler to fetch articles based on various filters such as tag, author, favorited username, and feed status. It interacts with the database context to retrieve and filter article data.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: A record representing the query parameters for listing articles, including filters like tag, author, favorited user, limits, offsets, and feed indicator.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handler class that processes the article list query, applying filters, retrieving data from the database, and constructing the response envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronous method that handles the article listing query, applying filters such as feed, tag, author, and favorited status, and returns an envelope containing the articles and count.
